sparse-native-trace.barrier_policy: Mutually exclusive original/instrumented clones preserve original fence sequence; no added runtime barriers. Only program0 clocks/stores.

sparse-frozenN-staged.barrier_policy: Mutually exclusive original/instrumented clones preserve original fence sequence; no added runtime barriers. Only program0 clocks/stores.

native_latency_scope: Uninstrumented/instrumented whole MIX task duration from aclprof_op_summary. CPU transfer and Python submit excluded. Batch/replay metadata kept separately.
limits: PMU categories overlap and are not additive critical paths. Different metric groups can be collected in separate SDK replays.
Program0 PMU measurements and clocks do not stand for the whole launch. CSV rows are actor instances, not independent repetitions.
Scalar issue brackets and non-scalar WAIT instruction timestamps are not engine occupancy/completion. AIV clocks have separate origins; no precise cross-actor overlap inferred.
Logical A/B requested-byte volume is derived from program tiling; it is not physical DDR traffic or a cache-miss measurement.
SDK aic_cube_fops is preserved literally; it changes with command count although source mathematical work is invariant. Do not use it as validated FLOP work.
Only NVIDIA-selected initial config is P; earlier tile64/stage2 data are exploratory. Fused port identity requires matching frozen NVIDIA selection.
